title: Unpack the First and Last
goal: Extract the boundary elements of an array while ignoring the middle elements.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 1 Afternoon: Irrefutable Patterns

hints: A single underscore ignores exactly one item. Arrays with four items need a syntax for multiple items.
Pass the array value directly so its type matches the fixed array pattern.
explanation: `..` ignores all middle elements between `first` and `last`. A single `_` expects exactly one element, triggering `E0527` because four items remain. The pattern expects `[i32; 4]`, so passing `&arr` fails with type mismatch `E0308`.
